description: This file provides helper extensions for the ChannelsSettings class, including methods to convert milliseconds to Date objects and to generate NSImage instances from base64-encoded data URLs.

methods.name: date(fromMs:)
methods.description: Converts a millisecond timestamp (Double?) to a Date object, returning nil if input is nil.

methods.name: qrImage(from:)
methods.description: Parses a data URL string, extracts base64-encoded data, and converts it into an NSImage object, returning nil on failure.
